FP010ScalingChallenges.title: The 50-Order Breaking Point
FP010ScalingChallenges.subtitle: When TikTok success meets operational reality, every creator hits the same devastating wall. Manual processes that worked for 10 orders completely collapse at 50+.

orders.title: Order Overflow
orders.description: Your TikTok Shop is generating more orders than you can process manually. Each order requires data entry, validation, and routing - multiplied by 50+ daily.
orders.consequence: Orders pile up, customers wait, and you fall behind every single day

inventory.title: Stock Chaos
inventory.description: With manual tracking, your TikTok Shop shows products as available when they're actually out of stock. Overselling becomes a daily nightmare.
inventory.consequence: Angry customers, cancelled orders, and damaged reputation

shipping.title: Shipping Delays
shipping.description: Creating shipping labels one by one, comparing rates manually, and tracking packages individually turns shipping into a full-time job.
shipping.consequence: Delayed shipments kill customer satisfaction and repeat business

time.title: Time Burnout
time.description: What started as a side hustle now consumes your entire day. Order processing, customer service, and inventory management leave no time for content creation.
time.consequence: Creator burnout leads to declining content quality and growth stagnation

customers.title: Angry Customers
customers.description: Delayed processing, shipping errors, and inventory mistakes create a flood of customer complaints. Your reputation starts suffering.
customers.consequence: Bad reviews and word-of-mouth damage your brand's growth potential

stress.title: Viral Overwhelm
stress.description: When your content goes viral and orders spike to 200+ in a day, your manual system completely collapses. Success becomes your biggest problem.
stress.consequence: Viral moments turn into operational disasters instead of growth opportunities
